description: Shared Budget: one spending cap a whole TEAM of agents draws from (total, per day or per month), with a per-purchase max, an escalate line and allowed/blocked payees. Spend Gate is stateless, so 5 agents can each stay under $1 and spend $5 together; a Shared Budget keeps the one running total. Returns budget_id + owner_key + spender_key (shown once). Bookkeeping only: OMENZ never holds or moves money. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/budget/create, $0.002 via x402.)
